question: What maximum installed cost per crosswalk does the MUTCD allow for an RRFB system?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The MUTCD does not specify any maximum installed cost per crosswalk for an RRFB system. The provided evidence for Chapter 4L (Application, Design, and Operation of Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons) addresses where RRFBs may be used, how they must be designed and mounted, and how they operate — but it contains no cost limits or budgetary requirements of any kind. The evidence is insufficient to answer this question because the premise (that MUTCD sets a cost cap) is not supported by the material provided. Visual evidence: [Image 1] (Figure 4L-1) illustrates the placement of RRFBs at uncontrolled, marked crosswalks at an intersection but includes no cost information; [Images 5–7] (pages 777–779, Chapter 4L text) cover application, design, and operation provisions with no mention of installed cost. Citations: - Section 4L.01 Option §1 (p.736) - Section 4L.01 Standard §2 (p.736) - Figure 4L-1 (p.737)
